decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external alterations hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall of the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Subject to appropriate safeguarding conditions, the alterations to the existing office building, because of their compatible appearance and position, would not harm the character and appearance of the property or the street scene, would not harm neighbours' living conditions and would not result in a decline in highway or pedestrian safety. The proposal would therefore accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development) and T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities for developments).
description: Erection of an infill porch extension, removal of six existing roof lights and installation of three new ones, installation of new door and two windows to southern elevation of existing office.
